title: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses

mechanism.populationDetail: Multiple harness candidates are searched and an archive/history is retained; no islands or explicit genealogy are described.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The evidence note reports score-based best-candidate selection; broader archive semantics are not specified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Full history is context for proposal generation and should not be conflated with an editable population.
mechanism.generationDetail: New harness code is proposed in an iterative loop conditioned on previous harness artifacts and complete run history; direct parent editing details are not explicit.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Expensive task scores, source, execution traces, and logs are reused as proposal context.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Score-based best candidate is retained, but no explicit editable-parent selection/crossover is required by the described loop.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Harness code itself is the optimized discovery-agent infrastructure, with full filesystem execution history as persistent context.
